reviews.author: Keshia Hayes
reviews.text: The receptionist Sierra is very unprofessional. She couldn’t show me a price list or their policy she stated that they didn’t have one. The company states they’re open 24 hours, but they’re not!!! My car broke down on a Friday around 5pm I went back, and It was towed around 8 PM.(IN THE STATE OF NC 24-48hrs is ABANDONMENT) The lady that I spoke with Friday night said that she would note that I tried to get my car the same day. I was charged over the weekend being that they were closed but say their 24 hours my total was $575 due to a flat tire. I highly do not recommend unless Sierra is outside cutting grass and from behind the desk.

reviews.author: Kate Fentress
reviews.text: Happened on a whim that Geico dispatched Brownie’s to tow me from Fayetteville all the way home to Columbia after being in Raleigh for work training today. Josh by far made this experience so much less stressful than I envisioned a 2.5 hour ride with just me and a driver would ever have been. So professional and courteous considering the distance he had to drive me. Thank you to Brownie’s and Josh for saving me tonight! Will be recommending you to my NC colleagues for sure!
